households.name: BFF
households.description: Free spirit Liberty, cheerful Summer, and geeky Travis are unlikely friends, and nothing can come between these three. Except perhaps the growing feelings both Summer and Liberty have for Travis...
households.lot_description: A sprawling colonial with landscaping perfect for outdoor entertaining.

households.name: Caliente
households.description: It’s no longer girls-only now that Caliente matriarch Katrina has moved in her mooching boy toy, Don. With three fiery, attractive ladies in the house, will Don remain faithful or will he get involved with more than one Caliente woman?

households.name: Pancakes
households.description: Poor, poor Bob and Eliza – have they ever been happy? It seems there’s nothing one can do to please the other. Just what is keeping this couple together? Or, conversely, what is the spark that will finally drive them apart?

households.name: Goth
households.description: The Goths are an aristocratic family with a dreary aura. Between Mortimer writing macabre stories and Bella's mysterious disappearances will Cassandra and Alexander grow up to be gloomy, too?
households.lot_description: History (and mystery) emanates from this tri-story Gothic mansion.

households.name: Landgraab
households.description: The Landgraabs seem like the perfect family; wealthy, well-mannered, brilliant. But Nancy and Geoffrey are each hiding something. Will their secrets tear them apart or will they continue to build a wealthy dynasty?

households.name: Zest
households.description: Johnny Zest has the stage name and the dream, but maybe not the talent... Disowned by the Landgraabs for quitting school, Johnny wants to make his own fame and fortune as a standup comedian.

households.name: Roomies
households.description: This household seems to have stepped right out of a TV sitcom. What wacky misadventures will the perky Zoe, easygoing Mitchell, uptight ladies’ man J, and intellectual Gavin suffer this week? Tune in and find out!

households.name: Spencer-Kim-Lewis
households.description: Okay, here’s the breakdown: Dennis Kim and Lydia Spencer had a daughter named Alice Spencer-Kim, then divorced. Alice married Eric Lewis and had her own little girl, Olivia Kim-Lewis. They live with Alice’s dad (Dennis, remember?) and Eric’s mom, Vivian Lewis. Hey, no one ever said family was easy!
households.lot_description: A large property with classical styling, this is the quintessential Garden Estates home.

dynasties.name: Abrantes
dynasties.description: The Abrantes have risen through the ranks to be known as the most refined Dynasty in Verdemar. But don't be misled by appearances: they always know how to get what they want.

dynasties.name: Thebe
dynasties.description: Strong as the tides, fierce as the sea, the Thebe are recognized by their family words: We Ride The Storm. This Dynasty is proud of their adventures and the treasures they've collected. Theirs is a mixed lineage which counts both princesses and pirates in their ancestry.

dynasties.name: Goth
dynasties.description: The Goths are an aristocratic family with a dreary aura and more than one skeleton in the closet. Perhaps it is their familiarity with death that fuel their deep passion?

dynasties.name: Monty
dynasties.description: After generations of drama and conflict with the Capps, the Montys are ready to rise from the ashes and claim back their power.

dynasties.name: Alto
dynasties.description: Passionate, loving...and toxic. That's the Alto trademark.

dynasties.name: Darong
dynasties.description: The Darongs are a philanthropic Dynasty who have worked tirelessly over generations to bring Dambele into a golden age of flourishing arts and wealth. Their family words are spoken throughout Dambele: Strength Through Union.

dynasties.name: Capp
dynasties.description: Everyone in Bellacorde admires the Capps and their family words, Bound By Honor. Theirs is an illustrious Dynasty known by many as romantic, chivalrous and proud. Some would also describe them as vain, elitist and melodramatic.

dynasties.name: Landgraab
dynasties.description: The Landgraabs seem like the perfect family; wealthy, well-mannered, brilliant. Yet, under that polished surface, they hide internal conflicts and a cut-throat agenda.
